decision.explanation: Each of these artists is correctly identified as the artist of an album titled "Brand New Me" in their respective contexts. Aretha Franklin is the artist of the 2017 compilation album mentioned in D1S1, D3S5, and other related documents. Dusty Springfield is the artist of the 1970 studio album described in D4S1 and D5S3.
